info.title: Vessel Particulars
info.description:
Vessel Particulars by CallSign
/callsign/{callsign}  GET

Vessel Particulars by Name
/vesselname/{vesselname}   GET

List of Vessel Particulars by name 
/name/{charset}   GET

Vessel Particulars by IMO Number
/imonumber/{imonumber}    GET

get.summary: Get vessel particulars by IMO number
get.description: Provides vessel particulars information for the given IMO number. The data is updated every 6 hours.

parameters.name: imonumber
parameters.description: IMO number of the vessel (1-10 chars, must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$)

200.description: Vessel particulars found. Returns an array of vessel particulars. Singapore-flagged and non-Singapore-flagged vessels have different schemas.
